_about: LTX-02's candidate blueprint forms for X-06 (the Lego story), prepared for the prose compiler of LTX-01. X-06 compares four anchor arms on the same 12-clip chain and seeds: none, style clause only, identity invariants only, both. Production text follows X-06; stories/lego-void/story.json is unchanged. Source: review 02 section 6 (examples 6.1-6.6) and section 7.1-7.2.
visual_style: A clean stop-motion product shot of a single LEGO minifigure standing centred on a seamless pure white cyclorama under even, shadowless studio light, a faint soft contact shadow beneath his feet and a flat, matte, evenly lit white field everywhere else; plain, neutral colours and a slight stop-motion snap to every movement.
